included: TAP, HOLD, SLIDE, TOUCH, TOUCH HOLD
BREAK, EACH, EX and officially documented special notation
legacy maidata.txt envelope as a non-core appendix

strictness_profiles.strict_core: Accept only combinations explicitly defined by the source pages and reject unresolved ambiguity.
strictness_profiles.compatibility: Parse uncertain combinations when tokenizable, preserve source text, and emit warnings.
strictness_profiles.round_trip: Preserve whitespace, modifier order, aliases and unknown nodes for lossless rewriting.

primary_english.title: Notations of simai
primary_english.scope: Celeca-defined official simai chart notation; excludes simulator-specific extensions

primary_japanese.title: simai語の譜面書式
primary_japanese.scope: Japanese counterpart; includes a 2026-03-24 update concerning non-center TOUCH HOLDs

legacy_maidata_container.title: maidata.txt内で使用する変数名
legacy_maidata_container.scope: Legacy 3simai maidata.txt variables; not part of the pure chart-notation grammar

number.sign: not documented; strict parser should reject signs
number.constraints: BPM, divider, count and duration are normally positive; exact waiting time may be zero in tolerant mode.

button.numbering: clockwise; button 1 is approximately at one o'clock

timeline.document_model: A chart is a sequence of zero or more slot definitions followed by E.
timeline.cursor_start: maidata first value in seconds; if unavailable, supplied externally by the host.

slot.structure: zero or more timing directives, optional note group, then comma
slot.event_time: notes in the slot occur at the current cursor before advancement
slot.advance: each comma advances the cursor by the currently active per-comma duration

musical_divider.semantics: Set per-comma duration to one T-th note at current BPM.
musical_divider.ordering_rule: When BPM and divider are initialized together, BPM must precede divider.

exact_seconds_divider.semantics: Set per-comma duration directly to S seconds.

termination.semantics: End at the current cursor after all preceding commas have advanced time.

semantics: First group occurs at slot time.
Each following backtick group is delayed by one additional millisecond.
Slash notes in the same group are exactly simultaneous.
Backtick-separated groups are not EACH and do not become yellow.

tap.modifier_order: b, x and the selected star token may be written in any order where documented.
constraints: A plain TAP is a button note; sensor notation creates TOUCH instead.

hold.modifier_order: h, b and x may be written in any order.

pseudo_hold.semantics: Instant-looking pseudo TAP implemented internally as an extremely short HOLD.

touch_hold.modifier_order: h and f may be written in either order.
touch_hold.syntax_scope: Official simai notation permits TOUCH HOLD at any sensor. The Japanese page notes that official non-center TOUCH HOLDs were implemented from PRiSM PLUS.

each.order_semantics: Order normally does not alter timing, but earlier SLIDE definitions may be rendered visually earlier.
each.compact_constraints: Strict profile permits compact form only for two or more unmodified, non-BREAK button TAPs.

ex.judgement_semantics: A hit within GOOD or better is treated as CRITICAL PERFECT.

concept.start_note: A SLIDE normally creates an approaching star-shaped TAP at its start button.
concept.trace_speed: constant from trace start to trace end for each complete slide or chain
concept.track_break_modifier: b after the final closing bracket
concept.track_break_scope: the entire SLIDE track or full chain

start_modifiers.b: BREAK modifier for the approaching start TAP
start_modifiers.x: EX modifier for the approaching start TAP
start_modifiers.@: render the automatic star-shaped start TAP as a normal TAP
start_modifiers.?: remove approaching start TAP; tracing star fades in before movement
start_modifiers.!: remove approaching start TAP; tracing star appears suddenly at movement start

modifier_distinction.warning: Combinations of @/?/! or b/x with a removed start TAP are not fully enumerated by the source. Accept only in compatibility mode unless tested.

w.name: fan
w.semantics: Creates three trace stars toward a fan of three endpoints.
w.inferred_branch_endpoints: For a start S and opposite declared end O, branches conventionally terminate at O-1, O, O+1 modulo 8; this branch expansion is an implementation inference, while opposite-end validity is normative from the table.

rules.>: all start/end pairs valid, including equal positions
rules.<: all start/end pairs valid, including equal positions
rules.p: all start/end pairs valid, including equal positions
rules.q: all start/end pairs valid, including equal positions
rules.pp: all start/end pairs valid, including equal positions
rules.qq: all start/end pairs valid, including equal positions

semantics: All tracks share one approaching start TAP.
Each track has its own path and duration parameters.
Additional tracks omit the repeated start button.
They are treated as an EACH because their tracing starts are described as simultaneous.
multiple_same_start.ambiguity: The source allows parameters to differ but also states trace starts are simultaneous. Explicitly different wait times are therefore implementation-sensitive and should trigger a compatibility warning.

common_duration.semantics: One constant speed is calculated for the whole chained path.

chaining.break_rule: Only one b may appear after the final duration; a partial BREAK segment is not allowed.

star_tap.$$: rotating star-shaped TAP with implementation-defined fixed rotation speed

starless_slide.?: No approaching star TAP; tracing star fades in.
starless_slide.!: No approaching star TAP; tracing star appears suddenly.

maidata_legacy_container.status: appendix; legacy 3simai container, not the normative chart grammar
maidata_legacy_container.override_semantics: Per-difficulty smsg/des/first overrides the global value when present.
maidata_legacy_container.warning: These escaping and variable rules are documented for 3simai and should not automatically be imposed on Majdata without checking Majdata's implementation.

recommended: Remove or skip insignificant whitespace while retaining source spans for round-trip mode.
Normalize C1 and C2 sensor aliases to C in the AST while preserving original spelling.
Normalize modifier order to semantic flags, not a canonical source order, unless serializing in canonical mode.
Store raw duration text and a parsed duration object.
Store both declared slide endpoint and expanded fan endpoints.
Keep source simulator/dialect metadata; do not silently interpret extensions as core syntax.

canonical_ast_coordinate.time: seconds plus rational musical position when a BPM grid exists
canonical_ast_coordinate.micro_offset: integer milliseconds from the containing comma slot

parser_pipeline: 1. Detect maidata envelope and select &inote_n content, or accept a raw chart string.
2. Strip/skip insignificant whitespace but retain source spans.
3. Scan timing directives, notes, comma separators and E.
4. Split each slot's timed groups by backtick, then split exact EACH members by slash.
5. Resolve compact plain-TAP EACH before parsing a multi-digit token as an error.
6. Parse each note into semantic flags; do not depend on modifier character order.
7. Parse slide path greedily (pp/qq before p/q; V consumes middle and end).
8. Validate slide shape endpoints and chain-duration completeness.
9. Advance the timeline once per comma.
10. Emit AST, diagnostics, source spans and dialect warnings.

diagnostic_codes.S009: Mixed per-segment and common chain durations
diagnostic_codes.S010: Partial BREAK in a chained slide
diagnostic_codes.S011: Invalid compact EACH containing a modified/non-TAP note
diagnostic_codes.S012: Unsupported modifier combination; retained in compatibility mode
diagnostic_codes.S016: Multiple-slide explicit waits may not be simultaneous
diagnostic_codes.S017: Maidata variable is legacy or dialect-specific

known_ambiguities.handling: The included EBNF is a normalized implementation grammar derived from examples and prose, not an author-provided grammar.
Only explicitly documented order-independence is normative. Other combinations should parse with warnings in compatibility mode.

known_ambiguities.topic: Multiple slide tracks with explicitly different wait times
known_ambiguities.handling: The prose says parameters may differ and also that movement begins simultaneously; flag differing explicit waits.
Unknown tokens must be preserved as extension nodes in round-trip mode, not silently assigned core semantics.
The English page is dated 2023. The Japanese page contains a 2026 update regarding official non-center TOUCH HOLD usage, without changing core syntax.
